title: Oil and gas company drills beside the mesa drill site
summary: Breaks Silence tells of Oil and gas company drills beside the mesa drill site, about last year at northern border of Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: northern border of Skinwalker Ranch, Utah

tellings.quote: all of a sudden an oil and gas company appears, ramrods permits through

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property linked to UFO claims where he says something lies underground, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about a strange turn of events. He says that last year an oil and gas company suddenly showed up, rushed its permits through, and began drilling on the ranch's northern border, right beside the spot where his own team had been drilling on a mesa. He tells it because the timing seemed too close to be chance.
